generic_lessons: A syntactically valid JSON response may contain a function call placeholder or a path rather than executable source. Validate the standalone source body before any Native execution.

A protected-call helper must document its return convention, and every getter result must actually be assigned. Wrapping calls in pcall does not establish functional correctness or identity protection.

An accepted end-turn input may stop at a normal diplomacy choice. Keep the single issued action, answer through original TEST_PLAYER UI, then independently read the actual next turn; never replay merely because a bounded readiness poll expired.
No new actor means no activation acceptance. Preserve a clean empty journal and report unmet prerequisites rather than granting a unit or reusing a legacy actor.
An incident popup without an actor identifier is evidence of an incident, not exact correlation to a specific observed unit. Keep unknown identity and possible hostile-turn causes explicit.

Future wrappers have installation boundaries and context scope. Read all sample indices once and restore exact own callbacks; zero captured army requests in one context does not prove global zero orders.

A source change that passed software checks still needs its own clean runtime startup, actual ordinary turns, and save/load readback; record nondefault scenario settings and distinguish online game speed from client network mode.
